children: Financial advisor
Colin Gates, CPWA®
recently joined the branch channel of Ameriprise Financial, Inc. (NYSE:AMP) from Merrill Lynch, Pierce, Fenner & Smith Inc. where he managed more than $120 million in client assets. Gates has joined
The Atlantic Group
, a well-established Ameriprise financial advisory practice led by founding partners and next-generation advisors
Andrew Lerner, APMA™, AWMA™, CFP, ChFC®
, and
Logan Shalmi APMA™
in Boca Raton, Fla.

As Gates evaluated the next chapter of his business, he prioritized finding a firm and team aligned with his long-term vision for clients and growth. The opportunity to join The Atlantic Group, a rapidly growing Ameriprise team led by next-generation financial advisors who share his vision for long-term growth, made the decision especially compelling.

"Ameriprise immediately stood out because of its commitment to helping advisors grow and the investments it continues to make in technology, planning capabilities and operational support," said Gates. "Those resources will help me deliver an even better experience for clients while creating greater efficiencies in my practice. Combined with the opportunity to join The Atlantic Group, a team that's building for the future and shares my growth-minded approach, it became clear that Ameriprise was the right fit for the next chapter of my business."

Gates and Shalmi have known each other for years, having attended high school together. That longstanding relationship, combined with a shared philosophy around client service and practice management, made the move a natural fit.

"As I explored different options, I kept coming back to the combination of Ameriprise and The Atlantic Group," said Gates. "Logan, Andrew and the team have built an impressive business with a collaborative culture and a clear vision for where they're headed. The opportunity to be part of that environment while continuing to elevate the client experience with the tools, resources and support of Ameriprise was especially appealing."

Since transitioning from Oppenheimer to Ameriprise in October 2025, The Atlantic Group has continued to build significant momentum, adding three financial advisors, three support staff members and more than $400 million in client assets. Today, the practice includes 12 financial advisors and 10 support staff members who collectively manage approximately $2 billion in client assets.
The team is supported locally by Ameriprise Branch Manager
Drew Granauro
, Ameriprise Complex Director
Daniel Landrau
and Ameriprise Regional Vice President
Michael Rearden
